name: Cooling
author: ismoil
description: Fans and temperatures on any machine, with the power modes it offers: Auto keeps it quiet at rest and medium at work, Max spins the fans to full speed (optional root helper). Says so when Linux sees no fan. No process per reading. English and Russian.

barWidget.description: Fans, temperatures and the power mode

schema.label: Power mode
schema.description: auto: quiet while the computer rests, medium while it works. manual: the mode you click stays.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: auto follows the system locale (Russian or English).

schema.label: Text size
schema.description: Scales the popup text. Text is never smaller than 13 px.

schema.label: Bar tachometer
schema.description: Show the main fan's RPM and a tachometer gauge beside the temperature in the bar.

schema.label: Animations
schema.description: Turn off to stop the fan icons from spinning.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds, at least 1)
schema.description: How often the sensor files are re-read. No process is started for it.
